description.value:
You produce a small technological trick, creating one of the following effects within range:

An instantaneous, harmless sensory flourish — a shower of sparks, a puff of air, a snatch of music, or a strange smell. Instantly igniting or extinguishing a light source. Instantly cleaning or dirtying an object no larger than 1 cubic foot. Chilling, warming, or flavoring up to 1 cubic foot of nonliving matter for 1 hour. Marking an object or surface with a color, symbol, or small design that lasts 1 hour. Fashioning a hand-sized trinket or illusory image that lasts until the end of your next turn.

Casting this power repeatedly, you can maintain up to three of its non-instantaneous effects at once, dismissing any of them as an action.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, At-Will
